method: Independent exact arithmetic and explicit derivation, separate from animation code
general_argument: A positive starting amount X retained by factor a>0 becomes aX; restoring X requires factor1/a, hence fractional increase1/a-1. With a=0 restoration by multiplication is impossible. Equal decrease/increase p gives(1-p)(1+p)=1-p^2.
limits: Fixed-width vessel makes height proportional to amount. No financial recommendation or claim about physical evaporation rates.
